class="AZgcHf"><h3 class="w6Zsc D0aEmf  ">Build with Gemini 3</h3></div><div class="AlLELb uqyP5b"><div jsaction="rcuQ6b:npT2md" jscontroller="M0Q3Qb" data-is-cws-richtext="true" class=" "><p>Gemini 3 It is available to all Gemini Code Assist Standard and Enterprise subscribers who are in the <a href="https://developers.google.com/gemini-code-assist/docs/configure-release-channels" rel="opener" target="_blank">Preview release channel</a>.</p><p><br /></p></div></div></div></div><div class="" jsname="pofbfd" ssk='1#1'><div class="qPg9F  q1Plf "><div class="AZgcHf"><h3 class="w6Zsc D0aEmf  ">AI assistance at terminal</h3></div><div class="AlLELb uqyP5b"><div jsaction="rcuQ6b:npT2md" jscontroller="M0Q3Qb" data-is-cws-richtext="true" class=" "><p>Gemini Code Assist gives you access to <a href="https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Gemini CLI</a>, an open source AI agent that brings the power of Gemini directly into your terminal. Gemini CLI provides powerful AI capabilities, from code understanding and file manipulation to command execution and dynamic troubleshooting, offering a fundamental update to your command line experience.</p></div></div></div></div><div class="" jsname="pofbfd" ssk='1#2'><div class="qPg9F  q1Plf "><div class="AZgcHf"><h3 class="w6Zsc D0aEmf  ">Agents for development tasks</h3></div><div class="AlLELb uqyP5b"><div jsaction="rcuQ6b:npT2md" jscontroller="M0Q3Qb" data-is-cws-richtext="true" class=" "><p>Gemini Code Assist's <a href="https://developers.google.com/gemini-code-assist/docs/use-agentic-chat-pair-programmer#before-you-begin" rel="opener" target="_blank">agent mode</a>, currently in preview, pairs you with agents capable of performing a wide range of tasks across the software development lifecycle. It expands the capabilities of simple command-response interactions inside chat, with support for multiple file edits, full project context, built-in tools, and integration with ecosystem tools using MCP, all while incorporating Human in the Loop (HiTL) for needed oversight.</p></div></div></div></div><div class="" jsname="pofbfd" ssk='1#3'><div class="qPg9F  q1Plf "><div class="AZgcHf"><h3 class="w6Zsc D0aEmf  ">AI code assistance</h3></div><div class="AlLELb uqyP5b"><div jsaction="rcuQ6b:npT2md" jscontroller="M0Q3Qb" data-is-cws-richtext="true" class=" "><p>Gemini Code Assist completes your code as you write, and generates whole code blocks or functions on demand. Code assistance is available in many popular IDEs, such as <a href="https://cloud.google.com/gemini/docs/codeassist/write-code-gemini#vs-code" rel="opener" target="_blank">Visual Studio Code</a>, <a href="https://cloud.google.com/gemini/docs/codeassist/write-code-gemini#intellij" rel="opener" target="_blank">JetBrains IDEs</a> (IntelliJ, PyCharm, GoLand, WebStorm, and more), <a href="https://cloud.google.com/workstations/docs/write-code-gemini" rel="opener" target="_blank">Cloud Workstations</a>, <a href="https://cloud.google.com/code/docs/shell/write-code-gemini" rel="opener" target="_blank">Cloud Shell Editor</a>, and supports most <a href="https://cloud.google.com/gemini/docs/codeassist/supported-languages" rel="opener" target="_blank">programming languages</a>, including Java, JavaScript, Python, C, C++, Go, PHP, and SQL.</p></div></div></div></div><div class="" jsname="pofbfd" ssk='1#4'><div class="qPg9F  q1Plf "><div class="AZgcHf"><h3 class="w6Zsc D0aEmf  ">Natural language chat</h3></div><div class="AlLELb uqyP5b"><div jsaction="rcuQ6b:npT2md" jscontroller="M0Q3Qb" data-is-cws-richtext="true" class=" "><p>Through a natural language chat interface, you can quickly chat with Gemini Code Assist to get answers to your coding questions, or receive guidance on coding best practices.
